'''Squan Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located near [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]] that served as a minor trade stop. [[Noham]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] lived there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="FC" />
